_comment: EASY Operations config. EASIEST PATH: delete this file's copy and let the app's first-time setup wizard write it for you — it signs in with a WordPress username + application password and stores this per-instructor format. OFFICE/SHARED MODE: instead of wpUser/mode/instructor, use the legacy format: {"mediaAuth": {"user": "", "appPassword": ""}, "postAuth": {"user": "", "appPassword": ""}} — instructor details are then typed into the app by hand. Generate FRESH application passwords in WordPress — never reuse ones that were pasted into chat or email. Do not commit the filled-in file. Card-printer matching: "printerName" (exact name picked by the setup wizard) wins; otherwise "printerNameContains" (substring, default "Nisca PR5350") is used.

wpUser.appPasswordEnc: (written by the app when OS-keychain encryption is available; preferred over appPassword)
